access_token.description: Zoom OAuth access token for the ordinary Zoom API, sent as a Bearer token. Never logged.

chatbot_client_id.description: Zoom Chatbot client ID used only by the declared Chatbot client-credentials token exchange. Never logged.

chatbot_client_secret.description: Zoom Chatbot client secret used only by the declared Chatbot client-credentials token exchange. Never logged.

key_connector_jwt.description: Customer Managed Keys Hybrid archival JWT, signed by the operator's JWKS and sent only to the declared Key Connector operation origin. Supply through environment or stdin; never logged.

base_url.description: Ordinary Zoom API base URL override for tests or proxies.

chatbot_token_url.description: Zoom Chatbot client-credentials token endpoint. Used only by declared Chatbot operations; the client ID and secret are sent with HTTP Basic authentication.

key_connector_base_url.description: Customer Managed Keys Hybrid Key Connector base URL, including the required /api/v2 suffix. Used only by the archival key-decryption operation and must point to the operator-provisioned customer-hosted Key Connector.

user_id.description: Zoom user id or email the 'meetings' and 'webinars' streams are scoped to (required for those streams; substituted into the user-scoped path).

page_size.description: Records per page (1-300); sent as the 'page_size' query param.

max_pages.description: Currently unused: the Zoom cursor paginator does not consume this configuration value.

mode.description: Runtime mode: live (default) or fixture for credential-free conformance.
